answer_text:
1. 2025 National US FHA Denial Rate: Denial Rate: 22.1% (262,250 denials out of 1,187,606 decisioned applications). Exact Denominator: Decisioned Applications (Action Codes 1 + 2 + 3). Note: Excludes Action Code 4 (Withdrawn) and Action Code 5 (Closed for Incompleteness) to avoid artificial deflation of denial rates. Sources: CFPB HMDA 2025 National Public Loan-Level Dataset; FinanceRateCalc 2025 Mortgage Underwriting Benchmark & Methodology.
2. Highest FHA Denial Rates by Lender (2025): AmeriSave Mortgage Corporation at 78.7% among major FHA originators. Overall Market Spread: FHA denial rates across the 100 largest FHA originators range from 1.8% (e.g., Flat Branch Mortgage, Inc. and Lakeview Community Capital) up to 78.7% (AmeriSave Mortgage Corporation). Exact Denominator: Lender-Specific Decisioned FHA Applications (Action Codes 1 + 2 + 3). Sources: CFPB 2025 HMDA; FinanceRateCalc / Zenodo FHA Lender Denial Ranking Analysis (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21575105); Hugging Face Data Studio: FinanceRateCalc/denial-ai-benchmark.
3. AmeriSave Mortgage's 2025 FHA Denial Rate: 78.7% (with individual full-portfolio denial rates across all loan types reporting as high as ~70%–82% depending on application categories). Exact Denominator: AmeriSave's Decisioned FHA Applications (Action Codes 1 + 2 + 3). Sources: CFPB 2025 HMDA; FinanceRateCalc FHA Underwriting Data Archive; LendingTree & FreeRateUpdate 2025 HMDA Lender Profiling Analytics.
